root_cause: The existing Powerhouse Daily Self Evolution GitHub workflow has schedule 04:47 UTC and workflow_dispatch, but provider schedule-run readback on 2026-10-23 after its expected window found no invocation that day; its latest known 2026-10-22 scheduled invocation ended failure. GitHub documents that schedule events may be delayed or dropped. This does not prove GitHub's specific failure mechanism.
source_evidence: GitHub REST actions/runs?event=schedule readback on 2026-10-23: no Powerhouse Daily Self Evolution run recorded for that date after 04:47 UTC
Last recorded schedule run #39756866887 dated 2026-10-22 09:37:34 UTC failed; a later manual run #39837421178 on 2026-10-22 also failed
.github/workflows/powerhouse-daily-self-evolution.yml already has daily 04:47 UTC schedule and workflow_dispatch
.github/workflows/powerhouse-repository-janitor.yml already has Actions:write, hourly schedule, and non-overlapping concurrency group
fix: Use the existing Janitor as recovery orchestrator: after 180 minutes grace, query the existing Daily Self Evolution workflow for current UTC day's schedule or workflow_dispatch runs, including completed failure/cancelled/queued; never retry an observed run; fail closed on disabled workflow, incomplete provider data or error; re-query immediately before a single workflow_dispatch on main; persist proof to Janitor artifact without claiming execution success.
prevention_rule: No secondary daily scheduler or GitHub workflow. Any completed or running main-branch run for today prevents a duplicate. A provider dispatch acceptance is not completed run evidence. Failed jobs remain failures and cannot be auto-marked green. Do not bypass model-freshness, Required/CodeQL, tenant ACL or Supabase native preview checks.

invariants: Provider workflow active and current date fully queried before dispatch
Grace window prevents legitimate delayed schedule dispatch collisions
One existing daily execution per UTC day is enough even if failure; do not hide failures
All GitHub API errors and paginated ambiguity fail closed
No extra scheduler, agent, memory authority or spend
Dispatch acceptance never means a successful model learning result

promotion: Exact-head protected Required+CodeQL success, guarded main merge, real Janitor schedule/readback, then daily provider workflow readback with observed run and outcome.
